screens.name: Home — default, omen fixture, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 15 shows the dominant gold orb, available and unavailable omen states, and enlarged content; supplied runtime reports Home clearance checks.
findings: Reduce enlarged decorative spacing so the omen is easier to discover, while retaining the orb as the primary invitation.

screens.name: Approach — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows the opening message and next-step explanation with substantial changes in orb position and text alignment across sizes.
findings: Keep the opening message anchored consistently through the transition to reduce apparent movement.

screens.name: Question composer — self, large text, task and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 01, 03, 35 and 36 show context, labeled question, disclosure and submission; supplied runtime reports visible enlarged submission and draft retention.
findings: Replace the visually doubled textarea outline with a cleaner field and focus treatment.

screens.name: Question composer — named person, collapsed, reader and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 02 and 24 show Alex context above an underline-style question field, with enlarged submission and supplied draft/focus verification.
findings: Make the unfocused question's editability more apparent without requiring activation.

screens.name: Named-person editor — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show selected Someone, labeled first name and confirmation; supplied runtime reports validation, cancel retention and return focus.
findings: Keep Cancel changes readily discoverable in the enlarged editor alongside confirmation.

screens.name: Listening — voice failure, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 16 shows a specific microphone failure with prominent typing fallback and voice retry, supported by reported local recovery testing.
findings: Use a state-specific failure heading so the opening invitation does not compete with the recovery message.

screens.name: Question card 1 — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows progress, a complete prompt and four choices at both text sizes; supplied runtime reports adaptive question execution.
findings: Make the relationship between plan certainty and choices such as Barely started more explicit.

screens.name: Question card 2 — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 04–05 show consistent progress, a clear obstacle question and four separated choices with enlarged reflow.
findings: Add captured selection-to-next-question feedback to establish continuity after a choice.

screens.name: Question card 3 — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show the final support question, 3 of 3 progress and four readable choices.
findings: Demonstrate the final choice's transition into processing so completion feedback can be assessed.

screens.name: Custom answer — empty, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 shows preserved question context, labeled input, disabled Continue and its explanation; supplied runtime reports constrained-height draft and focus checks.
findings: Separate progress from Back to choices more clearly in the enlarged header.

screens.name: Planning — loading, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 22–23 show the current operation, bounded wait expectation and Cancel; supplied evidence reports timeout, cancellation and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Preserve the specific operation and credit reassurance through every loading phase.

screens.name: Research — loading, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 26–27 distinguish context gathering from planning and retain Cancel, with supplied runtime recovery and motion evidence.
findings: Give the two processing phases a slightly stronger textual distinction while retaining the shared visual treatment.

screens.name: Planning failure — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows retry and question editing at normal size, while enlarged decorative content pushes retry almost entirely below the initial viewport.
findings: Shrink the enlarged error illustration and heading footprint so recovery appears sooner.

screens.name: Prediction failure — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 08–09 show retry, answer review and question editing, with the enlarged heading consuming most of the first viewport.
findings: Prioritize Try again and Review answers above the enlarged decorative error treatment.

screens.name: Sensitive planning redirect — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 29–30 show support first, explanation, alternative question actions and no-credit reassurance; supplied runtime reports sensitive redirect execution.
findings: Keep the credit and storage reassurance easier to reach in enlarged text.

screens.name: Sensitive prediction redirect — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 30 preserves the same support-first recovery structure after prediction, with reported no-credit-loss behavior.
findings: Reduce enlarged heading space to bring the alternative-question action fully into view sooner.

screens.name: Reveal — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 28–29 show a strong normal reveal, but enlarged text leaves the forecast unfinished in the first viewport and visibly splits conversation.
findings: Use a less expansive enlarged headline style and word-safe wrapping so the forecast remains easy to read.

screens.name: Check-in — default, large text, task and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 07 and 35 place outcomes before evidence and sharing, and supplied runtime reports visible first outcome at 200%.
findings: Explain why the November check-in precedes a forecast described as occurring by spring.

screens.name: Check-in — saved Yes
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 shows both Saved · Came true and a checkmarked Yes, with supplied runtime reporting persisted history updates.
findings: Retain the textual saved confirmation alongside the selected outcome.

screens.name: Check-in — saved Not quite
screens.evidence: Sheet 21 shows Saved · Not quite and a checkmarked matching option, supported by reported outcome persistence.
findings: Keep the saved wording aligned with the chosen option when revisiting the reading.

screens.name: Check-in — saved Not yet, normal and enlarged task
screens.evidence: Sheets 21 and 35 show saved pending status and selected Not yet at both sizes, while the supplied evidence says reminder scheduling remains unchanged.
findings: Clarify whether Not yet changes any future reminder so the saved status does not imply rescheduling.

screens.name: Evidence overview — collapsed, large text, reader, task and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 25, 27 and 36 show a clean category index with counts and Back; supplied runtime reports complete content and keyboard return checks.
findings: Retain the compact index and category descriptions as the evidence entry point.

screens.name: Evidence overview — expanded forecast context
screens.evidence: Sheets 36–37 show Which forecast expanded beneath the categories, with supplied runtime reporting preservation of the full headline and qualification.
findings: Make expanded context easier to locate at 200% without losing the user's position in the category index.

screens.name: Evidence reader — Your answers, large text, focused and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 and 23 show separated answer blocks and focused headings, with supplied complete-content and keyboard-return verification.
findings: Use neutral human-readable answer labels for legacy entries without inventing original questions.

screens.name: Evidence reader — Assumptions, large text, focused and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 10 and 24 show a dedicated assumption reader with qualification, Back and visible heading focus, supported by complete-content checks.
findings: Keep long assumptions readable as prose while preserving a predictable return action.

screens.name: Evidence reader — Why this forecast, large text, focused and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 11 and 25 show multiple explanatory blocks with quiet separators and focused headings; supplied runtime reports entire original explanation retention.
findings: Strengthen visual separation between explanation blocks without adding unsupported semantic headings.

screens.name: Evidence reader — Current sources, large text, focused and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 and 26 show source dates, external-link actions and an explicit background-only disclaimer with reported complete-content checks.
findings: Keep each Open source action tightly associated with its publication and date in enlarged layouts.

screens.name: Free forecast explanation — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 28–29 show a direct explanation reader with Back above the title, supported by reported free-boundary and focus-restoration checks.
findings: Improve scanning between explanatory paragraphs while retaining the original content.

screens.name: History — empty, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show local-storage context and a single Ask the Ball invitation in the empty state.
findings: Retain the direct empty-state invitation without adding secondary competing actions.

screens.name: History — populated, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a readable normal row but the enlarged date wraps Oct into Oc and t beside a very tall forecast.
findings: Reflow the date above the row at 200% and prevent month labels from breaking.

screens.name: History — stress list and persisted outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows multiple dated entries and a persisted Came true label; supplied runtime reports history/outcome persistence.
findings: Check equivalent multi-row content at 200% after correcting the date-column reflow.

screens.name: Age confirmation — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 16–17 show two explicit age choices and no birthday requirement, with supplied age-gate runtime checks.
findings: Retain equally readable age-choice labels and the minimal data explanation.

screens.name: Birthday onboarding — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 17–18 show optional labeled date fields that stack at 200%, with Continue and Skip below the enlarged initial viewport.
findings: Reduce enlarged vertical spacing so the optional Skip action is discovered sooner.

screens.name: Age restriction — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 18 clearly states the restriction and offers birthday correction, supported by supplied blocked/correction runtime checks.
findings: Preserve the explicit restriction and single correction route.

screens.name: Birthday correction — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 19 shows a required correction form and return route, with supplied validation and eligibility-boundary checks.
findings: Tighten spacing in the stacked enlarged form to bring Check birthday closer to the fields.

screens.name: Focus onboarding — unselected, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 19–21 show four focus options and an enabled Meet the Ball action, while the enlarged capture begins partway through the heading.
findings: Make proceeding without a selection explicitly read as skipping, rather than relying on the introductory instruction.

screens.name: Focus onboarding — selected, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 20 shows Learning & growth marked with text color, a check and a rule; supplied runtime reports focus updates.
findings: Preserve the checkmark as the non-color selection cue.

screens.name: Plans — yearly selected, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 22 shows annual and monthly pricing, packs and simulation labels; supplied runtime reports simulated purchase execution.
findings: Retain a visible test-mode indication in enlarged scrolled views as well as on individual purchase actions.

screens.name: Share — default, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 32–33 show the export preview, enlargement link, dimensions and privacy explanation, supported by actual PNG evidence.
findings: Reduce the enlarged preview section's vertical footprint so Download image is reached sooner.

screens.name: Share — expanded invite/reminder controls and task states
screens.evidence: Sheets 32–33 and 37 show separated download, invitation, reminder and return actions at both sizes.
findings: Use destination-specific cues for invitation and reminder actions rather than the same generic external arrow.

screens.name: Shared-image inspection / Story — normal, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 31–32 and 34–35 show a larger card and Image text section, with supplied scalable transcript and keyboard-return evidence.

screens.name: Export — preparing
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows disabled Download image and Preparing image; supplied retained evidence reports one polite status and one encode under double activation.

screens.name: Export — failure and retry
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows the retained preview, an explicit export failure and Try download again, supported by reported successful retry PNG output.

screens.name: Sky — sample/offline, selected question, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 33–34 show honest sample/offline labeling, selected Love and Ask this too, while enlarged topics become a long vertical list.

screens.name: Circles — offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows offline status, Retry, disabled creation and unavailable eligibility, while supplied evidence separates local adapter tests from production availability.

screens.name: You — profile and memory, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheet 39 shows birth profile, plan and editable memory sections, with supplied save/reload and memory Undo verification.
findings: Reduce enlarged spacing between profile utilities so plan and memory controls are easier to discover.

screens.name: You — birthday editing, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 38–39 show labeled fields, Save, Cancel and removal disclosure, supported by supplied persistence and birthday-removal boundary checks.

screens.name: You — optional birth details, large text and transition
screens.evidence: Sheets 37–38 show optional time/city fields and disabled city search, with supplied live geocoding and chart calculation evidence.
findings: Move Close birth details after the form or make it a compact disclosure control so the form begins sooner.

screens.name: You — settings controls, normal and large text
screens.evidence: Sheet 31 shows labeled sound, motion and text switches with enlarged selected state, supported by supplied keyboard, storage and motion checks.
findings: Keep section boundaries recognizable when scrolling beneath the persistent header.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: Home, approach, processing and reveal sheets show a consistent illustrated orb, with supplied reduced-motion and draw-timing checks.
findings: Blend the visibly rectangular mist boundaries around some orb placements into the surrounding atmosphere.

components.name: Bottom tab bar
components.evidence: Home, Sky, History and You show labeled tabs with selected accents; supplied bounds checks report all rendered targets at least 44×44.
findings: Verify that enlarged scrolled content can always clear both the bar and the raised central orb.

components.name: Wordmark and balance header
components.evidence: Headers consistently show branding or page title and reading balance, with balances wrapping to two lines at 200%.
findings: Give enlarged balance text a more compact intentional layout to reduce persistent header height.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: Cream filled buttons have readable action labels and disabled export/custom-answer states, supported by supplied target and contrast checks.
findings: Preserve content-driven height for multiline enlarged labels.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold links and ruled text actions appear throughout recovery, sharing and profile screens, with supplied target and contrast evidence.
findings: Standardize which secondary actions use a rule, centered label or inline link.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Question cards show full-width separated choices at both sizes, but no captured pressed or selected intermediate choice state.
findings: Capture immediate activation feedback before advancing to the next question.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Composer sheets show persistent labels and focused/unfocused treatments, supported by supplied validation, draft and focus checks.
findings: Unify the underline and outline treatments so the field remains visibly editable in either state.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Sheets 01, 24 and 36 show enlarged questions and submission; supplied evidence reports exact text doubling and constrained-height custom-answer checks.
findings: Simplify the doubled outline while preserving clear keyboard focus.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheet 31 shows labeled on/off switches using thumb position and color, with supplied keyboard, persistence and target checks.
findings: Retain thumb position as a non-color indicator of state.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheet 15 shows both a daily omen and explicit No omen today recovery copy, while enlarged content continues below the visible area.
findings: Bring enlarged omen content closer to its label by reducing preceding decorative space.

components.name: Sky stars and selected question
components.evidence: Sheets 33–34 connect a checkmarked topic to its sample question and action, supported by supplied target bounds.
findings: Keep the selected question nearer the topic selector at 200%.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 07 clearly distinguishes offline retry, unavailable creation and disabled eligibility.
findings: Remove repeated introductory copy so the unavailable state is quicker to scan.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show date, question, forecast and outcome, but the enlarged month breaks across lines.
findings: Replace the narrow date column with a stacked date label when text is enlarged.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 22 shows a checkmarked yearly choice, total annual price, monthly equivalent and an unselected monthly alternative.
findings: Include a demonstrated monthly-selected state to verify equivalent feedback for both options.

components.name: Share preview card
components.evidence: Share and Story sheets retain the forecast qualification within the image, with supplied actual PNG and scalable transcript evidence.
findings: Keep enlargement and transcript access adjacent to the preview for users who cannot read its raster text.

components.name: Notice and recovery
components.evidence: Voice, export, sensitive and engine-failure states show specific alternatives and supplied recovery evidence.
findings: Apply the compact voice/export recovery hierarchy to enlarged engine-error screens.

components.name: Typography and spacing
components.evidence: The sheets consistently pair expressive serif headings with sans-serif utilities, but enlarged reveal and History text show problematic wrapping.
findings: Tune enlarged display typography separately from body scaling and prevent narrow metadata columns.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: Dark mist and restrained gold remain consistent, with supplied rendered-background contrast and reduced-motion checks.
findings: Soften hard-edged mist patches that reveal the illustration bounds behind several orbs.

components.name: Birthday input
components.evidence: Onboarding and profile sheets show persistent Day, Month and Year labels plus examples; supplied runtime reports valid/invalid and save/cancel checks.
findings: Reduce spacing between stacked enlarged date fields without reducing text or target size.

components.name: Age confirmation
components.evidence: Sheets 16–18 show unambiguous age choices and a dedicated blocked state, supported by supplied eligibility checks.
findings: Retain the explicit age wording across both choices and the blocked response.

components.name: Focus selection
components.evidence: Sheets 19–21 show selected and unselected options with a checkmark and an enabled continuation action.
findings: Label continuation as skipping when no focus is selected.

components.name: Birth-profile surface
components.evidence: Sheets 37–39 show Sun sign, age band, birthday and editing routes, with supplied persistence and chart calculation evidence.
findings: Compact enlarged utility spacing to keep the profile's next actions grouped.

components.name: Birth-details form
components.evidence: Sheet 38 shows time format guidance, city input and explained disabled search, supported by supplied geocoding execution.
findings: Place the editable fields before the oversized close action in the expanded section.

components.name: Named-person control
components.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show context switching, selected Someone and labeled first name, with supplied validation and draft-return checks.
findings: Keep the chosen name visible on return to the composer and preserve the explicit change affordance.

components.name: Evidence disclosure
components.evidence: Sheets 25, 27 and 36–37 show category counts and collapsed/expanded forecast context with reported focus and complete-content checks.
findings: Retain the original forecast and qualification together whenever context is expanded.

components.name: Export status
components.evidence: Sheet 12 shows preparing and recoverable failure states, supported by supplied polite-status, duplicate-activation and retry evidence.
findings: Keep status local to the export action and preserve a single announcement.

components.name: Outcome selection and saved status
components.evidence: Sheets 21 and 35 show all three saved outcomes with text and checkmarks, supported by reported persistence and polite feedback.
findings: Preserve the saved confirmation independently of color and selection styling.

components.name: Close, Back and progress controls
components.evidence: The sheets show persistent dismissal, labeled reader returns and numerical question progress, supported by supplied target and return-focus checks.
findings: Separate enlarged custom-answer progress from its adjacent Back to choices action.

limitations: All grades are provisional browser assessments based on the attached sheets and supplied runtime summary; no independent runtime drive or artifact inspection was performed.
For each item, A is the mean of hierarchy, typography and surfaces, F is the mean of clarity, feedback and accessibility, and overall is 0.4A + 0.6F; null dimensions are excluded.
The authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold is not met across every screen and component.

Below-viewport content is not classified as inaccessible merely because it requires scrolling; the packet reports scroll, layout and task checks, but does not independently establish every control's reachability here.
Static transition captures and reported entrance checks support provisional continuity assessment but cannot fully establish perceived motion or absence of distracting shifts.
The reported 246-layout sweep, target bounds, contrast checks, axe results and runtime journeys were supplied evidence rather than independently reproduced results.
Physical iPhone, VoiceOver, native Dynamic Type, keyboard, microphone, haptics, hardware timing, actual payments and OS share delivery remain unverified and are not certified by these scores.
Prior-round behavior is considered only as summarized in the supplied runtime evidence; no previous rounds or graders were inspected.
Synthetic long-content predictions, labels and sources were treated as layout fixtures, not production-copy defects or evidence of model quality.
No demonstrated data loss, disguised error success or definitively inaccessible primary control establishes a hard-gate failure from this packet alone.
No repeated novice-use evidence supports a score of 10.
topFixes: Fix enlarged History date reflow: Oct currently breaks into Oc and t.
Rework the 200% reveal headline so long words remain intact and the forecast is less fragmented.
Reduce enlarged engine-error decoration so retry and answer review appear sooner.
Tighten enlarged birthday, optional birth-details and share layouts without reducing text scale or target size.
Unify question-field focus styling and improve the unfocused field's edit affordance.
Clarify the relationship between the forecast horizon, early check-in date and unchanged reminder schedule.
Blend hard-edged mist illustration boundaries into the otherwise coherent borderless background.
